rows.en: I had absolutely nothing to do. I was bored out of my mind.

ghs.en: There is nothing to do. Truly free time indeed.

rows.jp: ずいぶん遅れて、冬子はやってきた。
「なるほど、それで遅れたのか」
rows.en: “So that’s what took you so long.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I see, that's why you are late then."

rows.jp: からかうと、怒りの形相。
rows.en: I teased her. She glared daggers.

ghs.en: I pick on her, so she looks angry.

rows.jp: いやたぶんからかわなくても同じだった。
rows.en: She probably would have looked the same even if I hadn’t.

ghs.en: Nah, it's likely that even if I hadn't picked on her it'd have been the same.

rows.jp: 「どうして一人で行くのよ！　どうして起こさないの！？」
rows.en: “Why did you leave alone? Why didn’t you wake me?!”

ghs.en: Touko: "Whyyy did you go on alone! Whyyy didn't you wake me up?!"

rows.jp: 「それより食い物をいろいろかき集めて食おう、空腹なんだ」
rows.en: “More importantly, let’s collect whatever food we can find. I’m hungry.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "More importantly, let's scrounge up all kinds of eatery and eat, I hunger."

rows.jp: それから二人で、いろいろな食べ物を探した。
rows.en: The two of us went looking for food.

ghs.en: And after, that the two of us searched for all sorts of eatery.
In the houses nearby, in the shops,

rows.jp: 冬子は憮然としていた。ずっと。

ghs.en: Touko looked discouragedly disappointed. All throughout.

rows.jp: 生ものを避ければ、手にはいるのはパック食品や乾物ばかりだ。
rows.en: Avoiding perishables left us mostly packaged food and dried goods.

ghs.en: Having avoided raw food, we have acquired only packaged foodstuff and drinks.

rows.jp: しかもレトルトも知らない冬子にいちいち説明していたため、時間ばかりかかってしまった。
rows.en: Touko didn’t even know what a boil-in-the-bag meal was, so explaining every item took forever.

ghs.en: And then, having to explain one by one every detail to Touko who was ignorant even of the concept of retort pouch took a lot of time.

rows.jp: それでも二人で安っぽい昼食を摂る頃には、機嫌を直していた。
rows.en: Even so, by the time we shared our cheap lunch, her mood had recovered.

ghs.en: But in the end, when it came for the two of us were having our meager lunch, she had regained cheer.
